s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion, a grated carrot and herbs. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Cut into 16 and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.

Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and 1 tsp salt, add 300ml milk and mix to a soft dough. Shape a round, cut a cross on top and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: they finally make it to Alice
m.how: Rub 800g kangaroo fillet with 1 tsp ground pepperberry, garlic and oil. Roast 800g sweet potato wedges at 200C for 35 minutes. Sear the fillet hard to rare, rest 5 minutes and slice. Serve with warmed plum sauce.

w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 3 passionfruit and 250g strawberries.

d.note: the show at Alice Springs, finally on stage
d.how: Blend 150g raspberries with 1 ripe peach (or 200g tinned peaches, drained) and 1 tbsp sugar syrup until smooth, then strain. Spoon 30ml purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Top slowly with 150ml cold sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry. Use sparkling grape juice for an alcohol-free version.
